problem:
If $A={4,8}$ and $B={x,y,z},$ which of the following elements belong to $A\times (A\times B)?$

- $(4,(8,z))$
- $(8,(8,x))$
- $(8,4,y)$

feedback.problem:
If $A={v,w}$ and $B={3,4,5},$ which of the following elements belong to $A\times B\times A?$

- $(v,4,5)$
- $(v,3,w)$
- $(w,5,w)$
feedback.worked_solution:
The Cartesian product $A\times B\times C$ consists of all ordered triples whose first coordinate belongs to $A,$ second coordinate belongs to $B,$ and the third coordinate belongs to $C.$

In this case, $A\times B\times A$ consists of every combination of ${v,w}$ with ${3,4,5}$ and ${v,w},$ which results in

$$
\begin{aligned}A\times B\times A={ & (v,3,v),(v,3,w),(v,4,v),(v,4,w),(v,5,v),(v,5,w), \\  & (w,3,v),(w,3,w),(w,4,v),(w,4,w),(w,5,v),(w,5,w)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Note that

$$
|A\times B\times A|=|A|\cdot |B|\cdot |A|=2\cdot 3\cdot 2=12.
$$

From the given options, we see that both $(v,3,w)$ and $(w,5,w)$ are in $A\times B\times A.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only."
